court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court, Salem (HMOP No.141 of 2022 and GOP No.362 of 2022)
facts_of_case: Petitioner is wife who is unemployed and living with parents. She has two minor children with respondent. She wants to transfer case from Family Court at Salem to Namakkal.

legal_principles.principle: The place of the wife is her choice for conducting trial in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: The Courts have consistently held that the place of the wife is the choice for conducting trial in matrimonial cases.

legal_principles.principle: The place of wife is to be preferred for conducting trial in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court also held that the place of wife is to be preferred for conducting trial in matrimonial cases.

legal_principles.principle: The residence of the wife determines the question of jurisdiction in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: It is the residence of the wife, which determines the question of jurisdiction, in case the proceeding was initiated at the instance of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The place of wife is the choice for conducting trial in matrimonial cases, and courts should give a meaningful interpretation to beneficial provisions meant for women.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, this Court is of an opinion that both the cases filed by the respondent before the Family Court at Salem is to be transferred.

outcome.final_order: Case transferred from Family Court, Salem to Family Court, Namakkal.

use_for_drafting: using Indian Kanoon for divorce cases
practical application of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
